ns2:course.label: Beginning Sculpture
ns2:course.description: Introduction to basic concepts, processes, and materials in sculpture, with an emphasis on the relationship among these three aspects of producing works of art. Materials including wood, plaster, and clay will be used additively to fabricate, model and cast forms. Subtractive methods utilizing carving, and the making of meaning via materials, methods and context are also discussed. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: Restricted to Art and Design majors.
